title: Propositional Logic
summary: This unit covers the full lifecycle of propositional logic: informal foundations, formal syntax, semantics (truth assignments, satisfiability, validity), natural deduction, normal forms (CNF, DNF), resolution, and Tseitin's polynomial CNF encoding.
learning_objectives: Master propositional logic syntax and semantics.
Convert formulae to CNF and apply resolution.
Use Tseitin's algorithm for efficient SAT encoding.
